phase_name: Record the positive-pathspec hazard in the staging-scope standard

objectives.description: Add the Positive-Pathspec Ignore-Advisory Hazard subsection to git-staging-scope.md, beside the existing :(exclude)-side passage

notes: The new subsection's prose avoids pointing readers to the document's existing 'Exit-Code Contract and Safety Gates' section for the V7 gate, since updating that mirrored exit-code table and gate-label list was out of this phase's declared scope (the Scope Hypothesis requires the only added hunk to be the new subsection). It instead cites the script's own header directly. A follow-up could later extend that mirrored table with V7, but doing so here would have violated the single-hunk scope constraint.
